draft.body:
Thanks for connecting. Like I mentioned, I came across the New College Grad Embedded Firmware Engineer opening at Micron in Boise and thought my background lines up well with what the role is asking for.

I have hands on experience programming STM32 peripherals directly in bare metal C at the register level, including GPIO, timers, and I2C, without any HAL or RTOS abstraction. I have also designed and fabricated my own PCBs in EAGLE and implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed loop feedback, and spent a good amount of time debugging full hardware and software systems end to end through real integration issues across sensors, servos, and firmware.

If you think it could be a fit and are open to it, I would really appreciate a referral for the role. Happy to send my resume over whenever works for you.
draft.hook_used: Connection request accepted; this is the substantive ask that follows, not a stale follow up
